Where Chemistry Slips

Confident revision often fades when a fresh question lands. We focus on six places where working comes apart.

Mole Calculations

  • Mixes up units in multi-step conversions
  • We clarify the chain from start to finish

Equation Balancing

  • Stalls on multi-element equations under timing
  • We build balancing in clear stages

Mechanism Arrows

  • Muddles arrow directions in organic steps
  • We improve arrow conventions through practice

Periodic Trends

  • Jumbles trends across groups and periods
  • We organise trend logic by clear rules

Organic Naming

  • Slips on suffix and prefix order
  • We simplify IUPAC naming step by step

Practical Writing

  • Garbles method and result write-ups
  • We level the write-up to mark scheme standards

Our Chemistry Process

Frustration with chemistry grows for months before grades show. Our four-stage method levels the habits your child needs.

Step 1

Paper Diagnosis

Past chemistry scripts and class tests show exactly where the working slips.

Step 2

Foundation Build

Mole, balancing, and bonding basics get firmed up before any new content lands.

Step 3

Reasoning Practice

Fresh chemistry problems are tackled aloud so thinking becomes visible and correctable.

Step 4

Exam Simulation

Calm, examiner-style answers grow through full timed paper sittings.

Chemistry Syllabus Coverage

Every cluster matches the marking habits of major boards. Your child's answers stay exam-ready across all four curricula.

Physical Chemistry

Cambridge IGCSE 0620, Edexcel IGCSE 4CH1, A-Level 9CH0 and 9701

Energetics and kinetics fade under timed work. We dial in the calculation routes.

Inorganic Chemistry

AQA 7405, OCR A H432, AP Chemistry, IB Chemistry SL and HL

Trends and transition-metal questions drift off course. We sort the underlying patterns.

Organic Chemistry

Cambridge IGCSE 0620, A-Level 9CH0, AQA 7405, IB Chemistry SL and HL

Mechanism arrows and functional groups slip up on paper. We cement the conventions.

Analysis & Practical

Edexcel A-Level 9CH0, Cambridge A 9701, AP Chemistry, IB HL Option

Titrations and spectra readings derail under exam timing. We polish each interpretation.

Atomic & Bonding

Cambridge IGCSE 0620, Edexcel IGCSE 4CH1, A-Level papers, IB Chemistry SL

Bonding diagrams and electron configurations falter. We weave structure into reasoning.

Chemistry Thinking Skills

Memorised reactions stop helping when a question changes setup. We build the thinking your child uses for unseen work.

Equation Translation

  • Stumbles when turning word descriptions into equations
  • We turn word reactions into balanced equations. See also Mathematics

Mechanism Walkthrough

  • Hops between arrow stages in mechanisms
  • We slot each arrow into the mechanism logic

Product Prediction

  • Guesses products from given reagents
  • We tie predictions to reagent and condition rules

Structure Interpretation

  • Misjudges polarity and bonding from formulae
  • We pull structure cues that decide behaviour

Chemistry Paper Skills

Examiners reward clear chemistry writing as much as correct thinking. We polish the habits that earn full marks.

Lab Write-Up

  • Trims method detail examiners need
  • We layer write-up structure for full marks

State Symbols

  • Sidesteps state symbols on balanced equations
  • We stitch state symbols into every equation

Examiner Language

  • Writes answers in everyday phrasing
  • We tune wording to mark scheme keywords

Equation Layout

  • Squashes equations across crowded margins
  • We arrange equations with clear spacing
